title: Reproducibility Report for SC25 Paper Optimizing Quantum Circuit Mapping to Reduce Inter-Module Communications in Distributed Architectures
problem: Artifact evaluation and reproducibility assessment for quantum circuit mapping optimization work.
motivation: Validate and document the reproducibility of quantum circuit mapping techniques for distributed quantum-HPC architectures.
method: A reviewer tested whether the quantum circuit mapping code and data actually produce the results the authors claimed. The evaluation examined both the artifact description (what authors said was provided) and the evaluation appendix (detailed test results) to verify the work can be independently reproduced. This is part of SC25's reproducibility initiative, which systematically checks whether published research can be replicated.
key_novelty: A report verifying that quantum circuit mapping optimization code produces reproducible results.
baselines: Original paper: Cui et al., SC25
limitations: Reproducibility report only; no original technical contributions. Limited detail in abstract.
